req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies pagination functionality using 'skip' and 'limit' parameters. Tests are designed to verify correct behavior for typical, edge, and erroneous inputs, ensuring the API handles pagination as expected.

tests.name: test_pagination_positive_case
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=2.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Pre-load tasks into the database
client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 1", "description": "Description 1", "completed": False})
client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 2", "description": "Description 2", "completed": False})
client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 3", "description": "Description 3", "completed": False})

# Test pagination with skip=0, limit=2
response = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=2")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) == 2
assert response.json()[0]['title'] == "Task 1"
assert response.json()[1]['title'] == "Task 2"

tests.name: test_pagination_negative_case
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with negative skip value.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Test pagination with invalid negative skip value
response = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1&limit=2")
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value is less than the minimum" in response.text

tests.name: test_pagination_boundary_case
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=1.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Pre-load tasks into the database
client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 1", "description": "Description 1", "completed": False})
client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 2", "description": "Description 2", "completed": False})

# Test pagination with skip=0, limit=1
response = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=1")
